$Comment: A Grave Candle, what the Gravekeeper burns to open the Headless Horseman's graveyard (Hallows_Eve_Graveyard.json's EntryCost; the hard ride takes a Burning Grave Candle, Hallows_Eve_Offer_Burning_Grave_Candle.json beside this file). Requires opens it once Old Jack counts the player a Regular (Friendly with Old Jack's Favor); a locked offer still shows on the shelf with its lock line, and a friend without the rank still follows a party in free. Keep the lock the same as Hallows_Eve_Offer_Grave_Candle_Life_Essence.json's, and a rank below the Burning Grave Candle's (Trusted). No purchase limit and no rotation, since every party's ride needs one. SortOrder 5 puts it first on the lanterns shelf, where a player sent here by Old Jack or the Gravekeeper looks first; the same candle for Life Essence (Hallows_Eve_Offer_Grave_Candle_Life_Essence.json, SortOrder 6) sits straight after it where MMO Skill Tree runs. Cost is the price in Hallow Sweets: raise or lower the number to tune how often a party can ride. Named by the item's own keys.
